§ 3 Abs. 2 und § 5 Abs. 2 LkSG nennen Kr: Section 3 (2) and Section 5 (2) LkSG name criteria, not weights. Which preventive or remedial measures are appropriate is decided by the company, not by this number.
Kritisch: Punktzahl ab 75 oder Schwere a: Critical: score from 75 or severity from 85. The plugin assigns the trigger CAPA_REQUIRED. Remedial measures under Section 7 LkSG attach to an identified or imminent violation, not to a score.
Hoch: Punktzahl 50 bis unter 75. Das Plu: High: score from 50 to under 75. The plugin assigns the trigger AUDIT_REQUIRED.
Mittel: Punktzahl 25 bis unter 50. Das P: Medium: score from 25 to under 50. The plugin assigns the trigger QUESTIONNAIRE_REQUIRED.
Niedrig: Punktzahl unter 25. Das Plugin: Low: score under 25. The plugin assigns the trigger NO_ACTION. A low score does not prove the absence of risks; it may rest entirely on default values.
Zählt, was das Register für das Kalender: Counts what the register holds for calendar year %d (UTC). This is not a report under Section 10 (2) LkSG and not a BAFA form. Configure the year under Settings.
Nicht erfasst werden: die Zuständigkeit: Not recorded: internal responsibility (Section 4 (3) LkSG), policy statement (Section 6 (2)), preventive measures (Section 6), remedial measures (Section 7), complaints procedure (Section 8), and review of effectiveness.
Kalenderjahr, das die Jahresübersicht, W: Calendar year counted by the annual summary, WP-CLI, and the /bafa-report route when no year parameter is passed. Defaults to the previous calendar year.

Standardmäßig bleiben Lieferantenregiste: By default, the supplier register, assessment history, and self-disclosures are preserved when deleting the plugin (Section 10 (1) LkSG requires retention for at least seven years). Enable only if all data should be permanently removed.
Einen eigenen Schwellenwert gibt es nich: There is no custom threshold: levels follow fixed boundaries (critical from 75 points or severity 85, high from 50, medium from 25). The earlier threshold field was never read.
Abstrakte Stufe: 0,40 × Land + 0,40 × Se: Abstract level: 0.40 × country + 0.40 × sector + 0.20 × product. Concrete level: 0.40 × severity + 0.40 × probability + 0.10 × dependency + 0.10 × causal contribution, minus 10 for ISO 14001 and 15 for SA 8000. Overall: 0.30 × abstract + 0.70 × concrete. Country tiers (DE 15 to BD 85) and sector profiles are WM Suite heuristics, not a corruption index.
Die angemessene Weise eines Handelns bes: Appropriate due-diligence action is determined by the nature and scope of business activity, ability to influence the direct perpetrator, typically expected severity, reversibility, and probability of a violation, as well as the nature of causal contribution. The calculator asks for severity, probability, supplier dependency, and causal contribution; it does not ask for business scope, leverage, or reversibility.
Das Formular [wm_lksg_supplier_portal] s: The [wm_lksg_supplier_portal] form stores company name, country, sector, tier, checked certifications, and the confirmed wording with an HMAC signature. The submitter is not identified. A self-disclosure remains “unassessed”.
Zählt die Einträge des Registers für ein: Counts register entries for one calendar year. It is not a report under Section 10 (2) LkSG and not a BAFA form.
§ 10 Abs. 1 LkSG: „Die Dokumentation ist: Section 10 (1) LkSG: “Documentation must be retained for at least seven years from its creation.” By default, all tables and settings are kept when deleting the plugin unless permanent deletion is explicitly enabled under Settings.
